cost: English O(sum entity subtree bytes across recursive ancestors + output + oblique/role lookup work); chain copying can be quadratic. Hebrew O(B+W log W+VW+P log W+output) for bytes B, words W, verbs V and participant IDs P.
forward: English scans non-Bare frames in order and renders ten columns with original one-based indices. Hebrew projects accepted CoNLL-U fields, joins normalized MIds, and renders six columns. Empty inputs produce the respective no-frame note. These observations are bytes, not linguistic truth.

English composes phrase, ent, TAM and escaping. Hebrew composes hwords with hebrew_table. Inspected roundtrip site_code::tables removes the exact trailing note; its Hebrew sites call hwords then hebrew_table. External caller execution is not claimed.
inverse: Universe: finite supplied frame/word vectors paired with proposed bytes. Excluded families include a Bare frame rendered as its own row, dense renumbering after skipped Bare frames, a Hebrew row without nonempty Frame metadata and an earlier duplicate MId winning a participant lookup. These are source-derived inner exclusions, not exhaustive absent behavior.

For output y retain every vector whose rendered projections yield y. Varying English src/cause/next/quote fields alone leaves y unchanged. Hebrew accent removal, rejected CoNLL-U lines and overwritten MIds create additional fibers. Empty notes admit arbitrary Bare-only or frameless vectors. No original parse is uniquely recoverable.
limitations: Finite supplied inputs; no live parser, teacher, corpus, journal-backed tune or GPU.
